chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Uyayna, the seller of reeds, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I said to him, 'A woman died and left her husband.' He said, 'The wealth, all of it, is for the husband.'
ai.seo_question: Who inherits a wife's entire estate if she dies leaving only her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the principle of 'exclusive inheritance' (al-mirath li-wahid) in Shia jurisprudence, where the husband inherits the entirety of his wife's estate when no other heirs exist. It highlights the distinct Shia interpretation that the husband's share is not limited to a fixed portion but expands to encompass the whole, reflecting the comprehensive nature of his inheritance rights in the absence of competing claimants.
